title: NH men plead guilty to poaching bobcats, selling pelts in Canada
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Crime Over the course of four years, the men illegally exported at least 41 poached bobcat pelts, according to prosecutors.
Three New Hampshire men pleaded guilty to charges related to their scheme to illegally poach bobcats and export their pelts.

Maine Department of Inland Fisheries & Wildlife By Darin Zullo October 4, 2026 | 9:32 AM 2 minutes to read Three New Hampshire men pleaded guilty in federal court to illegally hunting wild bobcats and shipping their pelts to Canada, prosecutors announced Friday.
